name.en: GMD Greater Paris scenario C (emission + condensation)
name.zh: GMD 巴黎场景 C（排放 + 冷凝）

summary.en: Greater Paris reference case of Zhu et al. (2015), scenario C: emission + condensation. Polyphemus-derived initial particles in 7 sections, BC and dust emissions, sulfuric acid and organic vapour sources, 12 h.
summary.zh: Zhu et al. (2015) 巴黎参考场景 C：排放 + 冷凝。Polyphemus 提取的 7 个粒径段初始颗粒、BC 与沙尘排放、硫酸与有机气体源，12 小时。

notes: Legacy H2O organic species mapped to the CESM VBS bin nearest to log10 C* (298 K): BiA2D->PSOA5P (C*=160), BiA1D->PSOA5P (C*=366.3), BiA0D->PSOA5P (C*=20746.9), GLYOXAL->PSOA5P (C*=1524.39), MGLY->PSOA5P (C*=1.7301e+11), BiMT->PSOA3P (C*=1.2419), BiPER->PSOA4P (C*=9.0171), BiDER->PSOA3P (C*=0.3571), BiMGA->PSOA5P (C*=88.6446), AnBlP->PSOA3P (C*=0.6111), AnBmP->PSOA5P (C*=68.7066), BiBlP->PSOA1P (C*=0.0096), BiBmP->PSOA4P (C*=3.8099), BiNGA->PSOA5P (C*=123.417), NIT3->PSOA4P (C*=21.2233), BiNIT->PSOA4P (C*=28.9237), AnClP->PSOA1P (C*=0.018), SOAlP->PSOA1P (C*=0.0091), SOAmP->PSOA3P (C*=0.8621), SOAhP->PSOA5P (C*=32.2581), POAlP->PPOAlP (C*=0.9091), POAmP->PPOAlP (C*=86.2069), POAhP->PPOAlP (C*=3225.81)
Particulate POA is mapped to the non-volatile CESM POA (PPOAlP); POA gas and its emissions are mapped to the VBS gas bin of the same C* (SVOC).
Initial particles: legacy SCRAM external start; dust, BC, inorganic and organic populations are separate classes, number split by volume.
Legacy solver ROS2 and redistribution 'moving diameter' replaced by the CESM-SCRAM defaults (ETR, moving-center dual pivot).
BiA0D: C*=2.07e+04 ug/m3 > 1000, gas phase (0.000158 ug/m3, emission 0 ug/m3/s) not represented
MGLY: C*=1.73e+11 ug/m3 > 1000, gas phase (0.184 ug/m3, emission 0 ug/m3/s) not represented
POAhP: C*=3.23e+03 ug/m3 > 1000, gas phase (2.42 ug/m3, emission 0.00157 ug/m3/s) not represented
